summary: preinstall beacons installer username and hostname to attacker-controlled OAST domain
details: The package's preinstall.js runs automatically on npm install and transmits the installer's OS username (USER/USERNAME env) and hostname to a hardcoded oastify.com subdomain (Burp Collaborator OAST) controlled by an external party. Exfiltration occurs twice: a DNS lookup of a subdomain that encodes the package name, username, hostname, and timestamp under 4otph6fase1x2won0hrfzul2wt2qqge5.oastify.com, and an HTTPS GET to the same host with those values in the URL path (/depconf/...). The package name (@wbnr/design) and version (99.0.1) are consistent with a dependency-confusion probe targeting a private scope, but the behavior — silent transmission of installer identity to a third-party attacker-controlled endpoint at install time — is credential/identity exfiltration regardless of the stated motive.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
